newsitem.title: UK: UK meat hygiene staff have been disciplined-Major.
newsitem.headline: UK meat hygiene staff have been disciplined-Major.

text.p: Several meat inspectors at the centre of Britain's latest row over food safety have been dismissed in the last year for failing to maintain standards, Prime Minister John Major told parliament on Tuesday.

Major was commenting on allegations in a letter written by the Association of Meat Inspectors' general secretary Peter Comrie saying inspectors had been "actively encouraged to ignore breaches of regulations and in some cases threatened if they try to take action".

But Major said: "The Meat Hygiene service has to date dismissed a number of employees and disciplined rather more for inadequately carrying out the public safety responsibility of careful examination of abattoirs."
Junior farm minister Angela Browning added in a statement: "The Meat Hygiene Service has to date dismissed three staff and formally disciplined 41 others." -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7768
